{{Quote|Some feral shaupaut have moved into the area. Their pack leader, known as Blot, is especially nasty. Could you make them go away?|[[Vance Groten]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HKDPS" />}}
'''Blot''' was a feral [[shaupaut]] that lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Blot and its pack were leaving in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], near the city of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]].<ref name="SWG:HKDPS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Vance Groten]] recruited RSF agents to eliminate Blot and other aggressive shaupauts to protect the inhabitants of Dee'ja Peak.<ref name="SWG:HKDPS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blot appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HKDPS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Blot was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
